status: Final source-only native direction for host review; proposed surface unimplemented and tests unexecuted

identityDomains.sourceOperation: Immutable native-issued route/incarnation; stable across accepted memory/durable QoS2 retries, fresh after terminal packet-id reuse
identityDomains.sourceExecution: Exact server instance, session generation, owner fence where present and connection attempt; revocable without deleting already committed host operation
identityDomains.hostPlan: Immutable canonical publication/recipient/retained/expiry authority issued by exclusive host handler, privately bound to authenticated native context
identityDomains.recipientExecution: Distinct immutable lease per recipient enqueue attempt; read-only RecipientExecution on enqueue callback and outcome, internal constructor and exact registry association, captured generation/attempt plus Quiesced task. Shared Session.Items and receiver ID are diagnostics only

nativeLifecycle: Issue context privately, charge authority/task caps, apply permitted pre-acceptance interception, freeze copied canonical message, then invoke exclusive host acceptance outside locks.

Confirmed host result binds the exact frozen plan once. Rejected, uncertain or revoked result cannot become success through a later callback. QoS1 retransmission accounting remains separate from durable operation identity.

At retained write, recipient enqueue and success ACK, reserve exact execution under the synchronization that revokes it. Authorization check and mutation reservation must share a linearization boundary.

Revoke blocks future reservations. Asynchronously drain existing owned reservations; native Quiesced completes only when no new native mutation can start and prior reservations are terminal/reconciled. It does not claim that ignored-cancellation host code finished.

Activate successor only after relevant old mutation reservations quiesce. An unresolved drain timeout rejects/delays successor activation and triggers exact reservation recovery; no optimistic timeout-as-proof.

Observe every callback task. A cancelled callback still consumes its bounded callback slot until completion; its authority cannot reacquire execution permission. Retire operation authority only after terminal protocol/replay/Will handoff and no outstanding reservations or authorized recovery reference.

Callback-initiated Stop/Disconnect starts revocation and deferred drain; it must never self-await the current callback. No host await under native locks, deterministic lock ordering, explicit bounded incomplete-drain outcome.

qos2Windows.memory: After accepted PUBLISH/PUBREC, AwaitPubRel incarnation and one admission survive reconnect. Original source execution token remains revoked. Duplicate PUBLISH/PUBREL under successor use a new exact execution/ACK lease while preserving accepted identity. Completed retirement plus packet-id reuse issues new identity; never promote an old token.
qos2Windows.durable: Preserve existing exact owner/canonical transaction/journal-before-AwaitPubRel proof. Confirmed committed host plan survives attempt cancellation; uncertain native phase is resolved against its original issued operation, not reissued. PUBCOMP waits for exact Completed transition.

retainedReplay: Stable accepted record/revision snapshot semantics through both network and server subscribe paths. Replacement creates newer state for future replay; it never rewrites old canonical payload under old authority. Receiver takeover/cancellation revokes replay execution independently. No new source publication, retained write or recipient reselection during replay retry.
will: Dedicated registration/incarnation and scheduler-owner execution, independent of disconnected sender token. Native reconnect/suppression/stop ownership invalidates stale claims; actual dispatch establishes expiry anchor.
trustedInjection: Before-start origin registration returns opaque server-instance-bound capability. Strict overload validates exact registry membership, origin class and lifetime. A capability cannot claim network identity; foreign/null/revoked/publicly constructed context rejects. Legacy injection remains compatible only when strict policy is disabled.
canonicalPlan: Alias-resolved topic, copied binary payload and ordered properties, absolute expiry anchor/deadline, retain/QoS flags, NoLocal/shared selection/subscription identifiers, exact frozen recipient identities and intended private-marker stripping. Any post-acceptance mutation rejects rather than silently refreezing or selecting a different target.
hardBounds: Separate hard caps for source authorities, recipient attempts, mutation reservations and still-running callback tasks. Saturation rejects before side effect. Do not evict live records or forget ignored-cancellation tasks. Numeric defaults remain a host sizing decision; source preparation does not invent capacity.
distributedBoundary: Native registry and reservation prove only this server's mutation ownership. Redis source/retained/outbox commits still require atomic host fences. Redis consumer checkpoint/refund epoch is not a native delivery fence. Host must define and test cross-process final enqueue/admission receipt and crash reconciliation before horizontal activation; no native+Redis transaction guarantee is proposed.
remainingDecisions: Exact handler/result/capability registration type names and cap defaults
Host receiver authority to native exact recipient lease binding and final cross-process delivery failure window
Reentrant shutdown/deferred-drain completion surface and timeout reconciliation ownership
Strict forgery, post-acceptance mutation and saturated ignored-callback tests once API shape is agreed
hostedRedPlan: One <=10min separate Linux job, exact test SHA, focused named gap probes and legacy control, .NET8/10, seven-day receipts; validate exact missing-context failures instead of accepting arbitrary nonzero exit. Not dispatched during source-only preparation.
